description: Click a monitor cell, producing a monitor_touch event like a player right-clicking it, and return "ok" at once. Prefer craftos_act with touch, which waits for the program to react; use this one when it matters which player touched (player detectors, per-player menus). Find the cell to touch with craftos_ui.

player.description: Who touches (default: the interacting player); a name not in the world is an error.

name: craftos_touch_monitor
